# CoreClaw API Directory

> 118 production-ready API workers for web scraping, data extraction, and automation.
> Browse by category: E-Commerce, Social Media, Search/Maps, Jobs, Lead Generation, AI/Research, Developer Tools, Finance, Real Estate, Education, News.

## Categories
- E-Commerce & Marketplaces: Amazon Price, Amazon Product Scraper (Prices, Reviews & Listings), Amazon Reviews, Amazon ASIN Lookup, Amazon Best Sellers, Amazon Keyword Search, eBay Product Data, eBay Keyword Search, Walmart Product Scraper (by Keywords), Walmart Product Scraper (by URL), Shopify Product, Shopify Store Data, TikTok Shop Product, Etsy Product, AliExpress Product, Alibaba Supplier, Best Buy Product scrapers
- Social & Creator Data: Instagram Profile Data, Instagram Post, Instagram Reels Video, Instagram Hashtag, TikTok Profile Data, TikTok Video, TikTok Search, Twitter Profile Scraper (by Username), Twitter Post Scraper (by Post URL), Twitter/X Search, Facebook Post, Facebook Profile, Facebook Group, Reddit, Reddit Subreddit, YouTube Channel, YouTube Video, YouTube Search, YouTube Comments, LinkedIn Post, Pinterest scrapers
- Search, Maps & SEO: Google Search Results (SERP), Google Maps, Google Maps Reviews, Google News, Bing Search, DuckDuckGo Search, Yelp Business, BBB Business scrapers
- Jobs & Recruiting: LinkedIn Jobs Search, LinkedIn Company, LinkedIn Candidate Search (No Cookies), Indeed Job Search, Indeed Company, Glassdoor Jobs, Glassdoor Salary, ZipRecruiter Job, Dice Tech Job, RemoteOK Job, We Work Remotely scrapers
- Lead Generation: Google Maps Lead Finder, Amazon Seller, Crunchbase Company, Clearbit Company Lookup, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io Contact, Sales Genie Lead, Hunter.io Email Finder, Snovio Email, Domain WHOIS, LinkedIn Group, Company Website scrapers
- AI & Research: Google AI Answers, ChatGPT Response, Claude Response, Perplexity AI, Google Scholar, arXiv Paper, Semantic Scholar, PubMed scrapers
- Developer Utilities: SEO Audit Tool, On-Page Content Checker, Username Finder, Website Screenshot, PDF Text Extractor, HTML to Markdown Converter, JavaScript Renderer, IP Address Lookup, QR Code Generator, Website Availability Checker, Color Palette Extractor scrapers
- Finance & Markets: Financial Data, Stock Price, SEC Filing, Crypto Price, Forex Rate, Earnings Call, Insider Trading, Financial News scrapers
- Real Estate: Zillow Property, Redfin Property, Realtor.com, Airbnb Listing, Property Tax Data scrapers
- Education & Knowledge: Online Course, Book Metadata, University Program, Scholarship, Certification scrapers
- News & Media: BBC News, CNN News, Reuters News, TechCrunch, Hacker News, New York Times, The Guardian, Medium Article, Substack Newsletter, RSS Feed, Podcast Episode, Press Release scrapers
